name: Exp_TSI_DeMarker
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the TSI_DeMarker custom indicator, which combines DeMarker oscillator values with True Strength Index (TSI) smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position closing and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于TSI_DeMarker自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标将DeMarker振荡器与真实强度指数(TSI)平滑算法相结合。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于TSI_DeMarker指标的主线与信号线交叉，本质上是一个动量反转策略。入场条件为：当指标线处于信号线上方且前一周期指标线从下方穿越信号线时，触发买入信号；反之当指标线处于信号线下方且从上方穿越时，触发卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向交叉信号触发的平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金比例以及固定手数四种方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%的资金分配。策略使用了多重平滑算法（XMA）对DeMarker值进行处理，通过三个不同长度的平滑周期生成主线和信号线，从而过滤噪声并捕捉趋势动量变化。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the crossover of the TSI_DeMarker indicator's main line and signal line, essentially a momentum reversal strategy. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the indicator line is above the signal line and the previous bar's indicator line crossed from below the signal line; conversely, a sell signal triggers when the indicator line is below and crosses from above. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus closing positions on reverse crossover signals when the corresponding close flags are enabled. Position sizing supports four modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter defaulting to 0.1 (10% capital allocation). The strategy employs multiple smoothing algorithms (XMA) on DeMarker values, using three different smoothing lengths to generate the main and signal lines, filtering noise and capturing momentum shifts.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Trade funds ratio; negative = fixed lot

pros: 使用多重平滑算法过滤噪声，减少虚假信号
提供四种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
买卖开仓和平仓均可独立控制，策略配置灵活
使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号
止损止盈设置完善，风险可控
pros_en: Multi-layer smoothing algorithm filters noise and reduces false signals
Four position sizing modes offer flexibility for different risk preferences
Buy/sell open and close can be independently controlled for granular strategy configuration
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signal execution
Stop loss and take profit are properly set, keeping risk manageable
cons: 依赖自定义指标TSI_DeMarker，指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值较大，可能不适合所有品种
未检查当前是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高位差时段可能不利
信号仅在K线变化时检测，快速行情中可能错过入场时机
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator TSI_DeMarker; EA fails if indicator file is missing
Default SL 1000 and TP 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
No spread filter, which could be detrimental during high-spread periods
Signals only detected on new bar formation, potentially missing entries in fast-moving markets
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤器，在点差过大时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add position existence check to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction
Add spread filter to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 无同方向持仓检查，可能重复开仓导致过度敞口
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败仅打印日志但不阻止后续运行
固定止损止盈未根据市场波动性动态调整
risk_points_en: No same-direction position check may lead to duplicate entries and overexposure
Depends on external custom indicator; handle failure only logs but doesn't prevent subsequent execution attempts
Fixed stop loss/take profit not dynamically adjusted for market volatility
